title: Adenomyosis: Genomic Mechanisms and Biological Response
brief_summary: Examination of genomic and biologic responses to LNG-IUS in patients with adenomyosis.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Abnormal bleeding in the presence of Adenomyosis as demonstrated by MRI

Exclusion Criteria:

* Other causes of abnormal bleeding such as fibroids, endometrial polyps, malignancy
* Presence of endometriosis
study_population: Women with abnormal uterine bleeding due to adenomyosis
